'''After Shock''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] the walker was captured by the [[Eternal Empire]] and brought to [[Zakuul]]. The walker was eventually obtained by [[Zotar]], the [[Exarch]] of the [[Old World]], who also participated in gladiatorial combat in the [[Arena Grand]]. In [[3630 BBY]] Zotar was challenged for the title of the Eternal Champion by the "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]" and faced his challenger in After Shock. He was nevertheless defeated, and the walker was destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
After Shock appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as part of the tenth and final boss fight of the "Eternal Championship".
